name: DenseLines (density line charts)
title: A thousand short lines as one picture
what: Give every series one unit of ink per column, so a thousand lines become a readable density, not spaghetti.
pick_line: Gap-safe, weighted DenseLines in Rust with a Python binding.
data: SYNTHETIC mock budgets (Corning_mock, MS_mock), not any firm's budget
one: The shared 2022–24 dip and the 2025 split appear; spaghetti hides them.

findings.h: The authors' code breaks on programs that start or stop.
findings.t: One partial series turns a column blank (NaN). 274 of 1,052 Corning-mock programs are partial, so every column fails. Our one-line gap-safe fix: none.

findings.h: Chart plus keyword finds 94% of a hidden group, but it is fragile.
findings.t: AI-demand group, Corning mock. The brush works at 2–4 px smoothing and vanishes at 6–8 px.

chart.title: Share of the hidden group found (recall)

findings.h: At 5–6 points per line, the normalisation itself barely matters.
findings.t: The noisiest 10% of programs take 12.0% of the ink without normalisation and 10.7% with it (Corning mock). The density view is the gain.

chart.title: Ink taken by the noisiest 10% of programs

findings.h: Build 2026-11-23: the gap-safe Rust core is fast and small.
findings.t: Parity with the authors' reference to 1.4e-7 (relative), no NaN columns when series stop early, 10,000 series × 1,000 columns in 0.40 s, and 50,000 series in 1.35 s at 356 MB (the 11-13 run hit the 15.6 GB limit). SYNTHETIC inputs.

chart.title: Peak memory for 50,000 series, MB (lower is better)

findings.h: Build 2026-11-23: a little closer to the truth, and no false branches.
findings.t: Pre-registered, on mocks regenerated with a new seed: the DenseLines chart is closer to the true-path chart than the unnormalised one on both mocks (W1 0.0496 vs 0.0524; 0.0359 vs 0.0370). Shuffling years made the branch test fire in 0 of 200 runs, but it also missed the planted clusters, so that test has no power here.

chart.title: Distance to the true-path chart (W1, lower is better)

findings.h: Build step 4 input (2026-11-24): the dip test cannot see a planted branch; a mixture test can.
findings.t: SYNTHETIC, 10% of series branch at the last column, 500 runs per cell, 2,000 null runs per size. Hartigan dip: power 0 up to 2,000 series (size 0-0.25%). Two-component mixture likelihood-ratio test: power 0.82 at 500 series for a branch 2 SD away, 0.99 at 200 series for 3 SD, 0.82 at 2,000 for 1.5 SD (computed).
findings.note: The mixture test's size is set to 5% by calibrating on the same null simulations, so it is not an independent size check, and the null is Gaussian by construction.

chart.title: Power at 500 series, branch in 10% of series
